There are some easy safeguards you can put in place to keep your ISP and government from gathering your Internet data and history.

Use a VPN. They do cost a couple dollars per month, but they are an encryption tunnel through your ISP. PIA is a good choice.

Tor is free and easy to use. All your browsing will be encrypted and anonymized.

Use an encrypted email. There are good email services available like Tutanota and Protonmail that are free and secure. Google and others data mine your info and cannot be trusted.

There are many other safeguards you can also put in place, but these are a good starting point. The idea is to stay a few steps ahead of them at all times.
